title: Exotic Peruvian Beetroot Chupe De Camarones
description: A vibrant and flavorful Peruvian dish featuring beetroot and shrimp, with a mix of exotic spices and crispy agemono deep fry, this halal friendly chupe de camarones is a must try for adventurous foodies. It combines the natural sweetness of beetroot with the succulence of shrimp.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Add the diced beetroot to the bowl and mix until the beetroot is well coated with the spice mixture.
Deep fry the beetroot mixture in batches until crispy and golden brown.
In a separate pan, heat some oil and saute the shrimp until pink and cooked through.
Add the cooked shrimp to the deep fried beetroot mixture and stir well.
Serve the exotic Peruvian beetroot chupe de camarones hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
Traditionally, this dish is served with steamed rice or crusty bread.
To make it more substantial, you can add some boiled potatoes or corn to the dish.
